sections.theory:
(B) The provincial system

The caliphs of the Banu Abbas, for administrative convenience, divided the sultanate into many provinces. Considerable changes were made in the provinces of the era of the Banu Umayyah. The head of a province was called amir, wali or 'amil. The caliph himself appointed the amirs. In the beginning the amirs were transferred quickly, but later the amirs kept becoming permanent; rather, declaring their autonomy, they would obtain its deed from the caliph.

The amir himself appointed the provincial officials. In the era of the Banu Abbas's government there were approximately twenty-four provinces, among which the large provinces were as follows.

1. Egypt

2. North Africa

3. al-Jazirah, Azerbaijan and Armenia

4. Hijaz (Makkah, Madinah and Central Arabia)

5. Yemen, Kufa, Sawad

6. Basra, Bahrain and northern Iraq

7. Fars, Khurasan

8. Mawara' al-Nahr

9. Ahwaz

10. Sindh, Punjab

11. Syria

12. Southern Iran and Mosul

Department of justice:

Every town had its own deputy qadi. In the large cities there were qadis. In the beginning the provincial amirs appointed them, but later the Qadi al-Qudat of Baghdad appointed them directly. In matters of justice no concession of any kind was given. With all …

sections.title: سبق 25 — متن (121)

paras.text: … equal treatment was given. Deputy qadis were also called 'adil. The decisions of the disputes of non-Muslims were made by their own religious leaders. The biggest court of the country was called Dar al-'Adl. Its head was the Qadi al-Qudat or the caliph. The hajib and the vizier too performed the duties of judges. All the courts of the country worked under the Qadi al-Qudat.
paras.urdu: یکساں سلوک کیا جاتا تھا۔ نائب قاضی، عادل بھی کہلاتے تھے۔ غیر مسلموں کے جھگڑوں کے فیصلے ان کے اپنے مذہبی پیشوا کیا کرتے تھے۔ ملک کی سب سے بڑی عدالت دارالعدل کہلاتی تھی۔ اس کا سربراہ قاضی القضاۃ یا خلیفہ ہوتا تھا۔ حاجب اور وزیر بھی ججوں کے فرائض سرانجام دیتے تھے۔ ملک کی تمام عدالتیں قاضی القضاۃ کے ماتحت کام کرتی تھیں۔
paras.pashto: … یو شان چلند کېده. نایب قاضیانو ته «عادل» هم ویل کېده. د غیر مسلمانانو د شخړو پرېکړې د هغوی خپلو مذهبي مشرانو کولې. د هېواد تر ټولو لویه محکمه «دارالعدل» بلل کېده؛ مشر یې قاضي القضات یا خلیفه و؛ حاجب او وزیر هم د قاضیانو دندې سرته رسولې؛ د هېواد ټولې محکمې د قاضي القضات تر لاس لاندې کار کاوه.

paras.text: In the era of the Banu Abbas the department of intelligence was better organised. Government spies were spread in every corner of the country in the guise of merchants and preachers. They kept the caliph informed of all important events.
paras.urdu: بنو عباس کے دور میں محکمہ جاسوسی بہتر طور پر منظم کیا گیا۔ سرکاری جاسوس سوداگروں اور واعظوں کے بھیسوں میں ملک کے کونے کونے میں پھیلے ہوئے تھے۔ وہ خلیفہ کو تمام اہم واقعات سے باخبر رکھتے تھے۔
paras.pashto: د بنو عباس په دوره کې د استخباراتو محکمه ښه منظمه شوه؛ دولتي جاسوسان د سوداګرو او واعظانو په بڼه د هېواد په هر ګوټ کې خپاره وو؛ خلیفه یې له ټولو مهمو پېښو خبر ساته.

paras.text: The army of the Banu Abbas was counted among the best armies of the world. The army of the Banu Umayyah consisted only of Arabs. In the era of the Banu Abbas there were different divisions of the army. All the people of the realm could be recruited in them. Equal treatment was given to all people. In salaries too there was no difference of any kind. In Mansur's era there were three large divisions of the army.
